sanskrit: yayor apsu na mahimā nadīṣu praririce pradivi rocanāyām | yayor asty anumatir bhūyiṣṭhā viṣṇum agan varuṇaṃ pūrvahūtiḥ ||
english: Whose greatness overflows in the waters, in the rivers, in the luminous expanse of heaven above; whose consent is most abundant — the first invocation has reached Viṣṇu and Varuṇa.

sanskrit: yayor idaṃ pradiśi yad virocate prajām ati vi ca caṣṭe śacībhiḥ | mahaṛtasya dharmāṇā yuvānā viṣṇum agan varuṇaṃ pūrvahūtiḥ ||
english: Whatever shines in the quarters of the sky belongs to those two, who survey the creatures with their mighty powers; the two youthful upholders of the great cosmic order — the first invocation has reached Viṣṇu and Varuṇa.

sanskrit: ubhā jigyathur na parā jayethe na parā jigye kataraś canaiva vām | indraś ca viṣṇo yad apaspṛdhethāṃ tredhā sahasraṃ vi tad airayethām ||
english: Both of you have conquered; neither of you is ever conquered; neither of you two has ever been defeated in any way. O Viṣṇu, when you and Indra strove with each other in sport, you sent forth that thousand threefold.

sanskrit: yad aśuddhaṃ yad anṛtaṃ yac carāmasi pāpayā | āpo mā tasmād enaso duritāt pāntu viśvataḥ ||
english: Whatever is impure, whatever is false, whatever we have done through wickedness — may the waters protect me from that sin and from that wrongdoing on every side.

sanskrit: duṣvapnyaṃ durjīvitam ity ekā ||
english: Bad dreaming, bad living — thus one verse.

sanskrit: yad avāmṛkṣata kṛṣṇaśakunir mukhena nirṛte tava | agniṣ ṭat sarvaṃ śundhatu havyavāḍ ghṛtasūdanaḥ ||
english: Whatever the dark bird touched with its beak, O Nirṛti, as it belongs to you — may Agni, the bearer of oblations, the clarifier of ghee, purify all of that completely.

sanskrit: yad asmān kṛṣṇaśakuner niṣpatya tata ānaśe | āpo mā tasmād enaso duritāt pāntu viśvataḥ ||
english: Whatever has reached us from the dark bird flying down — may the waters protect me from that sin and from that wrongdoing on every side.

sanskrit: agnir mā pātu prathamo durarmaṇo nirṛtyāṃ viśvā duritāni mṛjmahe | viśve mā devā marutaḥ punantu varuṇo rājā savitā pavitraiḥ ||
english: May Agni, the foremost, protect me from evil-mindedness; we wipe away all misfortunes toward Nirṛti. May all the gods, the Maruts, purify me; may King Varuṇa and Savitā purify me with their purifying filters.

sanskrit: antarikṣeṇa patati yātudhānanibādhitaḥ | stokaṃ yam abhyacuścutat tam u syonaṃ kṛṇomi te ||
english: It flies through the midair, driven away by the demon-sorcerer. Upon whomever it has dripped a drop — him I make gentle and harmless for you.

sanskrit: yat tvā kṛṣṇo abhyamṛkṣad devebhyas pari nirhataḥ | śivaṃ te tanve tat kṛṇmo vi te pāśāṃś cṛtāmasi ||
english: That which the dark one touched you with, having been expelled from the gods — we make that auspicious for your body; we cut asunder your bonds.

sanskrit: tṛṣṭike tṛṣṭivandana ud amuṃ chindhi tṛṣṭike | yathā kṛtadviṣṭe daśat sarvasmai śepyāvate ||
english: O Tṛṣṭikā, worthy of bitter homage, cut that one asunder, O Tṛṣṭikā — so that it bites the one made hateful to all, the one who deserves to be reviled.

sanskrit: tṛṣṭāsi tṛṣṭikāsi viṣā viṣātaky asi | parivṛttā yathāsasy ṛṣabheṇa vaśeva ||
english: You are bitter, you are Tṛṣṭikā, you are poison, you are Viṣātakī. You are like a heifer that has been turned around by a bull.

sanskrit: ā te dade vakṣaṇābhya ā dade hṛdayād adhi | ā te mukhasya yad varca ā puṃso yat titṛpsasi ||
english: I take from you from the flanks, I take from above the heart; I take what radiance belongs to your face, I take what virile satisfaction you crave.

sanskrit: mayi varco mayi śravo mayi dyumnaṃ mayi tviṣiḥ | ahaṃ te varca ā dade ahaṃ bhūyāsam uttamaḥ ||
english: In me be the radiance, in me be the glory, in me be the splendor, in me be the brilliance. I take your luster for myself; may I become the foremost.

sanskrit: abhi prāgāt sahasrākṣo yuktvā śapatho ratham | śaptāram anvicchan yātu vṛka ivāvimato gṛham ||
english: The thousand-eyed one has gone forward, having yoked the chariot of the curse. Let it go seeking the curser, as a wolf goes to an unguarded house.

sanskrit: pari ṇo vṛṅdhi śapatha hradam agnir iva dahan | śaptāram atra tvaṃ jahi divyā vṛkṣam ivāśaniḥ ||
english: Ward off the curse from us, O cool pool, like Agni burning. Strike the curser here, like the divine thunderbolt strikes a tree.

sanskrit: yo naḥ śapād aśapataḥ śapato yaś ca naḥ śapāt | vṛkṣa iva vidyutā hata ā mūlād anu śuṣyatu ||
english: Whoever has cursed us without cause, and whoever has cursed us when we have cursed — like a tree struck by lightning, let him wither from the root on up.

sanskrit: śaptāraṃ yantu śapathā yaḥ suhārt tena naḥ saha | jihvāślakṣṇasya durhārdaḥ pṛṣṭīr api śṛṇīmasi ||
english: Let the curses go to the curser who, being a friend, acts against us. We also shatter the ribs of that smooth-tongued, evil-hearted one.

sanskrit: yaṃ dviṣmo yaś ca no dveṣṭy aghāyur yaś ca naḥ śapāt | śune peṣṭram ivāvakṣāmaṃ taṃ praty asyāmi mṛtyave ||
english: Whomever we hate, and whoever hates us, the evil-lived one who has cursed us — I hurl him down toward death, like a mortar tossed to a dog.

sanskrit: preto yantu vyādhyaḥ prānudhyāḥ pro aśastayaḥ | agnī rakṣasvinīr hantu somo hantu durasyatīḥ ||
english: Let the diseases go forth, let the afflictions go forth, let the reviling speeches go forth. May Agni slay the female demons, may Soma slay those who act with ill will.

sanskrit: pra catetaḥ pāpi lakṣmi naśyetaḥ prāmutaḥ pata | ayasmayenāṅkena yaṃ dviṣmas tasmin tvā sṛjāmaḥ ||
english: Go away from here, O evil portent; be annihilated; fly away from here to yonder. With the iron brand we release you upon whomever we hate.

sanskrit: yā tvā lakṣmīḥ patayālūr ajuṣṭ- -ādhicaskanda vandaneva vṛkṣam | anyatrāsmat savitas tām ito dhā hiraṇyahasto vasu no rarāṇaḥ ||
english: The ill-omened fortune that has clambered up over you like a creeper over a tree — O Savitā of the golden hand, bestowing wealth upon us, place that away from us, elsewhere from here.

sanskrit: nir araṇīṃ savitā sāviṣat pador nir hastayor varuṇo mitro aryamā | nir ādityā anumatī rarāṇāḥ pra ṇaḥ suvāt savitā saubhagāya ||
english: Savitā has impelled the fire-drill free from the feet, Varuṇa, Mitra, and Aryaman have freed it from the hands. The Ādityas, with Anumati bestowing grace, have freed it — may Savitā impel us forward toward good fortune.

sanskrit: ekaśataṃ lakṣmyaḥ sākaṃ martyasya januṣeha jātāḥ | tāsāṃ pāpiṣṭhā nir ataḥ pra hiṇmaḥ śivāsmabhyaṃ jātavedo ni yaccha ||
english: One hundred and one portents are born here together at the birth of a mortal. Of those, we drive the most evil one away from here; O Jātavedas, restrain what is auspicious for us.
